title: Prospective Analysis of Fetomaternal Risk Factors for the Development of a Risk Score for Pregnancy Complications
summary:
Every pregnant woman in Germany receives a Mutterpass (maternity record) after medical confirmation of pregnancy. This document contains a risk catalogue that determines the intensity of antenatal surveillance and care. However, many women are currently classified too broadly as “high-risk pregnancies,” even when no true risks are present.
The aim of the study is to determine the predictive accuracy of a new risk score for pregnancy and birth complications.
conditions: “Health complications that occur during pregnancy or childbirth and affect maternal and neonatal outcomes.
